description: This file defines the ViewsData class in Drupal, responsible for managing cached views data, lazy loading, cache interactions, and processing entity types within the Drupal views module.

classes.name: ViewsData
classes.description: Manages and lazy loads cached views data, handles cache interactions, and processes entity types for Drupal views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewsData object with cache backend, module handler, and language manager.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all table data, loading from cache if not fully loaded.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific table by key, rebuilding cache if necessary.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Fetches data from the cache backend.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores data into the cache backend.

methods.name: prepareCid
methods.description: Prepares cache ID by appending language code.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Loads all views data, invoking hooks and caching the result.

methods.name: processEntityTypes
methods.description: Links tables with entity types to their respective generic entity tables.

methods.name: fetchBaseTables
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of base tables with their metadata.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears internal storage and cache tags.
